stem: Which sentence best summarizes the excerpt?

options.label: F
options.text: At Mr. Cobble's store, people watch a young boy untangle a knot that many others have tried to untie and failed.

options.label: G
options.text: Mr. Cobble holds a contest at his store, and many people come to watch as a boy tries to untie a knot that is famous in the town.

options.label: H
options.text: Several spectators spend the day watching a boy struggle to untie a knot while they eat pizza and drink soda at Mr. Cobble's store.

options.label: J
options.text: A young boy accepts the challenge of untying a knot at Mr. Cobble's store and is able to do so after taking a nap.
